g.title: cluster_m1
g.text: M1 Verifier (done for sky, vegetation, props, ground, water)

g.title: cluster_m2
g.text: M2 Data generation (sky done: 293 examples; scale-up runs in progress for ground, water, vegetation, props: target 100+ each)

g.title: cluster_m3
g.text: M3 Fine-tune specialists (sky done; one size chosen: Qwen2.5-Coder-3B for every segment; min 100 examples)

g.title: cluster_m4
g.text: M4 Agentic loop (runs with the trained 3B sky specialist; composite verifier next)

g.title: cluster_m5
g.text: M5 Segments through M1-M4 (each needs: contract, rubric, brief sampler, checks, capture recipe) <- current milestone

g.title: cluster_m6
g.text: M6 RL with verifiable rewards (where SFT plateaus)

g.title: cluster_m7
g.text: M7 Holistic scene generation (one brief in, a playable scene out)

g.title: d1
g.text: time of day x weather x palette

g.title: v1->d1
g.text: the same verifier filters the data

g.title: l3
g.text: each layer alone, rendered in the scene

g.title: v6->l3
g.text: the same verifier accepts in the loop

g.title: l1
g.text: Claude Fable 5.1: scene brief -> segment briefs

g.title: t4
g.text: approval gated on pass rate (not yet run)

g.title: l2
g.text: sky: 3B adapter (3 briefs accepted end to end)
others: shipped gold layers until trained

g.title: l1->g0
g.text: repeat M1 to M4 per segment, in this order

g.title: h3
g.text: every layer from a small model, accepted by one verifier

g.title: l3b->h3
g.text: composite verifier is what makes M7 possible

g.text: ground3 (72 briefs) running, water2 + water3 next

g.title: g4
g.text: beach strong; street views + token cap fixed

g.text: verifier as the environment, reward = checks + judge win rate

g.title: g5->r1
g.text: cheap, honest rewards first: sky, ground, camera

g.title: h1
g.text: (a new biome proves the contract generalises)
